name: An 872-Concept Rooted Factor with a Noncontained Opposite Section
definition: Use the translated 289-concept rooted core $B$ with tips $x=64$, $\alpha=128$, and $\delta=290$, whose acquired-support bitmasks are $70,390,480$, in the two-coordinate construction of the opposite-section noncontainment proposition.
parameters: The output $Z$ has $872$ concepts, dimension $14$, and VC dimension $4$. Its corners are exactly $0,257,259,514,1161$.
properties: $Z$ is a rooted factor with degree-two root $0$ and four degree-four nonroot corners; every other nonroot vertex has degree at least four. Its opposite section contains $64$, absent from one side section, even after root-protected degree-two pruning. The complete sectionwise endpoint law still holds and zero is its unique critical root.
